### Background

Using the machine learning algorithms that are taught in STAT 212: Statistical
Machine learning, we can develop regression models that can predict future 
state based off of prior data. However, what the models in STAT 212 lack is a
spacial component. What spacial machine learning models help us incorporate 
spacial relations into the model, having the regression of one space be 
dependent on both its prior trends and those of its neighbors.

For our project, we will be using a spacial machine learning algorithm because 
feral swine 

### Running Spacial Machine Learning Algorithms

# Steps for Running Spacial Machine Learning Algorithms

## Step 1: Determine Spacial Autocorrelation

We first must determine spacial autocorrelation before we can even begin to run 
a spacial machine learning algorithm. Spacial autocorrelation determines if 
there is a spacial trend in out data or if there is a lack of trend. If there is
a lack of a trend, we can not move on with running a spacial machine learning 
algorithm.

# Moran's I

Moran's I is a method of determining spacial autocorrelation.

# Loading Packages
library(tidyverse)
